title: Best Intercom Alternatives
intro: Intercom's Fin AI agent has a strong independent reputation, but the $29+/seat/mo base plus $0.99-per-resolution AI billing pushes real monthly costs well past the sticker price for a lot of teams. Here's where to look if that math doesn't work for you.

entries.blurb: The closer enterprise-grade match — deeper ticket routing, skills-based assignment, and Admin Copilot for human agents, at the cost of a steeper learning curve and AI Agents locked behind the $55/agent/mo Suite Team tier.
The budget move — per-workspace pricing starting at $45/mo (with a usable free tier) instead of per-seat, if you're a smaller team that doesn't need Intercom's scale.

Worth a look if you want more explicit control over what an AI agent can read or write in your CRM — its attribute-permission model is more granular than what Intercom documents, though it lacks Intercom's independent review track record.
